Class Mode2027Support

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.terminal.Mode2027Support
public final class Mode2027Support extends Object
Utility class for Mode 2027 (grapheme cluster mode) terminal support.

Mode 2027 is a terminal feature that coordinates grapheme cluster handling between applications and terminals. When enabled, the terminal signals that it can handle complex grapheme clusters (ZWJ emoji sequences, regional indicators) as single display units.

Escape sequences:

  • Query (DECRQM): CSI ? 2027 $ p
  • Response (DECRPM): CSI ? 2027 ; Ps $ y where Ps=1 enabled, Ps=2 disabled but recognized
  • Enable: CSI ? 2027 h
  • Disable: CSI ? 2027 l

Terminals known to support Mode 2027: Ghostty, Contour, Foot, WezTerm, kitty.

See Also:
  • Grapheme Clusters in Terminals

  • Method Details

    • query

      public static Mode2027Status query(Backend backend, int timeoutMs) throws IOException
      Queries the terminal for Mode 2027 support status.

      Sends the DECRQM escape sequence and waits for the DECRPM response. If the terminal doesn't respond within the timeout, it is considered as not supporting Mode 2027.

      Parameters:
      backend - the backend to use for terminal I/O
      timeoutMs - timeout in milliseconds to wait for response
      Returns:
      the status of Mode 2027 support
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs during communication
